TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Greetings, I am your Mentat Cyril. Together we will purge this planet of the foulness of the other Houses. The High Command wishes you to produce 1000 credits. You may earn credits by building a refinery and harvesting spice.
TEXTA.ENG.text: Greetings, I am your Mentat Cyril. Together we will purge this planet of the foulness of the other Houses. The High Command wishes you to produce 1000 credits. You may earn credits by building a refinery and harvesting spice.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Congratulations! I knew that you would achieve your goal with very little trouble. I look forward to assisting you in future missions.
TEXTA.ENG.text: Congratulations! I knew that you would achieve your goal with very little trouble. I look forward to assisting you in future missions.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: This is very disappointing. We had such high hopes for you. We must insist that you try again. Our confidence is surely not misplaced, and we look forward to the successful completion of your first test.
TEXTA.ENG.text: This is very disappointing. We had such high hopes for you. We must insist that you try again. Our confidence is surely not misplaced, and we look forward to the successful completion of your first test.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: First build a two by two group of concrete slabs.  Then build a windtrap and place it upon the concrete.  Do the same for a refinery so that you can reach your quota of 1000 credits.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Greetings, I am honored to see you again. The High Command now requires that you produce 2700 credits in a new harvesting area. Unfortunately, we have confirmed the presence of an Ordos base in this region. Good luck!
TEXTA.ENG.text: Greetings, I am honored to see you again. The High Command now requires that you produce 2700 credits in a new harvesting area. Unfortunately, we have confirmed the presence of an Ordos base in this region. Good luck!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Well done! Our effort to maintain fair play on this planet is opposed by both the Ordos and the Harkonnen. The spice that you collected will help us greatly in our efforts.
TEXTA.ENG.text: Well done! Our effort to maintain fair play on this planet is opposed by both the Ordos and the Harkonnen. The spice that you collected will help us greatly in our efforts.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: The loss of this region to the Ordos will hurt House Atreides greatly. Please try harder next time. The seriousness of your mission cannot be overemphasized!
TEXTA.ENG.text: The loss of this region to the Ordos will hurt House Atreides greatly. Please try harder next time. The seriousness of your mission cannot be overemphasized!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: If you have a windtrap then build a barracks in order to produce soldiers. I would do so to provide a greater defense for your harvesting operation.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: The battle with the other Houses has intensified, and we are now forced to engage in some selected offensive maneuvers. The Harkonnen are being extremely troublesome in your next region, and we must ask that you remove their presence from the area.
TEXTA.ENG.text: The battle with the other Houses has intensified, and we are now forced to engage in some selected offensive maneuvers. The Harkonnen are being extremely troublesome in your next region, and we must ask that you remove their presence from the area.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Hurrah!  Although I prefer defense, a fine offensive against such a deserving foe as the Harkonnen is a joy to behold and a reaffirmation of all that is good and right. House Atreides thanks you for your efforts!
TEXTA.ENG.text: Hurrah!  Although I prefer defense, a fine offensive against such a deserving foe as the Harkonnen is a joy to behold and a reaffirmation of all that is good and right. House Atreides thanks you for your efforts!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: It is a cruel world, is it not? I'm not sure if I was expecting divine intervention, but as I watched your defeat I could not help thinking how unfair it was!
TEXTA.ENG.text: It is a cruel world, is it not? I'm not sure if I was expecting divine intervention, but as I watched your defeat I could not help thinking how unfair it was!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: You need to build a Light Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.
TEXTA.ENG.text: You need to build a Light Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Your demonstration of military skills now forces us to assign you to another offensive campaign against House Harkonnen. They have continued to attack our peaceful harvesters, and must be removed from the area!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Well done! No task seems too difficult for you. The Harkonnen will think twice before attacking our harvesters again!
TEXTA.ENG.text: Well done! No task seems too difficult for you. The Harkonnen will think twice before attacking our harvesters again!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Although I understand the problems confronting you, I will confess that I am disappointed by your defeat. I am not sure what went wrong, but please do not let it happen again!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: The addition of tanks in your forces is essential to your victory in this region.
TEXTA.ENG.text: The addition of tanks in your forces is essential to your victory in this region.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Welcome. The rules seem to have changed. As you have witnessed, the Emperor himself has been aiding the efforts of our competitors!  As a part of our new strategy, we must ask that you eliminate the treacherous Ordos forces that presently control this region.
TEXTA.ENG.text: Welcome. The rules seem to have changed. As you have witnessed, the Emperor himself has been aiding the efforts of our competitors!  As a part of our new strategy, we must ask that you eliminate the treacherous Ordos forces that presently control this region.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Congratulations again!  There seems to be no limit to your talents. I have to think that some divine force motivated your decision to serve within House Atreides. Our gain was certainly the others' loss!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: This defeat of yours will not look good in my reports. I am not sure how much longer we can afford to support you. There are many others clamoring to take your place, so I suggest that you do whatever is required to be victorious in your next encounters!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: As the battle for this planet intensifies, all efforts must be taken to ensure our success. Once again, we must call upon you to destroy our enemies in a troubled sector. House Harkonnen must be taught a lesson. Thank you, and good luck!
TEXTA.ENG.text: As the battle for this planet intensifies, all efforts must be taken to ensure our success. Once again, we must call upon you to destroy our enemies in a troubled sector. House Harkonnen must be taught a lesson. Thank you, and good luck!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Hurrah! We have them on the run now, and it's all because of you. Your successes have been remarkable! Are you sure you didn't graduate from one of the intergalactic military academies?
TEXTA.ENG.text: Hurrah! We have them on the run now, and it's all because of you. Your successes have been remarkable! Are you sure you didn't graduate from one of the intergalactic military academies?

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: There is a time for excuses, but this is not it!  I don't understand how you could have bungled the entire campaign! You have no choice but to apply yourself more diligently during your next assignment.
TEXTA.ENG.text: There is a time for excuses, but this is not it!  I don't understand how you could have bungled the entire campaign! You have no choice but to apply yourself more diligently during your next assignment.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.
TEXTA.ENG.text: I advise you to produce and then place Rocket Turrets at strategic defensive positions around your installation.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: The battle goes well, but there is no time to relax. We have an urgent need for you to subdue all Ordos forces in this region promptly. Our ongoing negotiations are aided immeasurably by corresponding victories in the field. We are counting on you.
TEXTA.ENG.text: The battle goes well, but there is no time to relax. We have an urgent need for you to subdue all Ordos forces in this region promptly. Our ongoing negotiations are aided immeasurably by corresponding victories in the field. We are counting on you.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Excellent! Your skill seems to improve with each assignment, and your exploits give great confidence to those on the home front. Keep up the good work!
TEXTA.ENG.text: Excellent! Your skill seems to improve with each assignment, and your exploits give great confidence to those on the home front. Keep up the good work!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: My goodness, what an awful defeat! Perhaps we have given you too much responsibility. If you fail at your next assignment we will have to seriously consider sending you home!
TEXTA.ENG.text: My goodness, what an awful defeat! Perhaps we have given you too much responsibility. If you fail at your next assignment we will have to seriously consider sending you home!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: The Sonic Tank is a powerful ally against enemy troops.
TEXTA.ENG.text: The Sonic Tank is a powerful ally against enemy troops.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Although you have earned a well-deserved rest, I'm afraid the political situation requires that we send you back into the field immediately. Both Ordos and Harkonnen forces have built up to unacceptable levels in this region, and now must be removed completely.
TEXTA.ENG.text: Although you have earned a well-deserved rest, I'm afraid the political situation requires that we send you back into the field immediately. Both Ordos and Harkonnen forces have built up to unacceptable levels in this region, and now must be removed completely.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: A masterful victory! Frankly, we would not be able to remain on Dune without your military guidance. We have come to rely completely on you sir, and cannot imagine further success without you!
TEXTA.ENG.text: A masterful victory! Frankly, we would not be able to remain on Dune without your military guidance. We have come to rely completely on you sir, and cannot imagine further success without you!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: A defeat is never welcome, but this loss is particularly devastating! All of our efforts may soon prove futile unless you can provide a victory in your next campaign!
TEXTA.ENG.text: A defeat is never welcome, but this loss is particularly devastating! All of our efforts may soon prove futile unless you can provide a victory in your next campaign!

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Utilize your Palace's special option whenever possible, for it costs nothing and it will recharge.
TEXTA.ENG.text: Utilize your Palace's special option whenever possible, for it costs nothing and it will recharge.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Your next assignment will determine the entire outcome of our efforts here on Dune. Victory will not come easily. In addition to destroying all remaining Ordos and Harkonnen troops, you are also instructed to subdue Emperor Frederick's forces. All of our hopes and dreams are riding with you, and we humbly beg of you to provide one final victory for our noble House Atreides.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Good Morning, your lordship, and congratulations!  You have served House Atreides well. We will not soon forget our most noble warrior! I go now to relay the news of your most glorious victory, and deliver your terms to the Emperor.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Your defects must have been inherited. Nobody could possibly learn the colossal stupidity that you have displayed.

TEXTA.ENG.digram_expanded: Watch for sneak attacks, defend your installations well.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: I am the Mentat, Radnor. With my guidance, you may be able to assist us in conquering this dusty, little planet. For your first test you will be expected to produce 1000 credits, and not a granule less. You may earn credits by harvesting spice, and will need to build a refinery to convert spice to credits. If any of our foolish enemies attempt to attack your base you will have the pleasure of seeing the invincible Harkonnen troops in action.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: You have pleased me. Continue to serve me well, and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
TEXTH.ENG.text: You have pleased me. Continue to serve me well, and I will see to it that you are rewarded.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: You are beneath my contempt. Do you know what happens to those who have failed House Harkonnen?
TEXTH.ENG.text: You are beneath my contempt. Do you know what happens to those who have failed House Harkonnen?

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: House Harkonnen has generously granted you a new opportunity to serve us. We will now allow you to take command in a more dangerous area, and accumulate 2700 credits. Although the worthless Atreides you may encounter in this region should always be eliminated as a matter of principle, the spice quota is your objective.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: Again you have pleased me. You remind me of myself in my youth. You may indeed have true Harkonnen blood coursing through your veins!
TEXTH.ENG.text: Again you have pleased me. You remind me of myself in my youth. You may indeed have true Harkonnen blood coursing through your veins!

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: I cannot believe that you were incapable of accumulating your quota. It was a simple task that should have let us examine your leadership capabilities. I suggest you do not try my patience further.
TEXTH.ENG.text: I cannot believe that you were incapable of accumulating your quota. It was a simple task that should have let us examine your leadership capabilities. I suggest you do not try my patience further.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: If you have a windtrap then build a House of WOR structure in order to produce troopers. I would do so to provide a greater defense for your harvesting operation.
TEXTH.ENG.text: If you have a windtrap then build a House of WOR structure in order to produce troopers. I would do so to provide a greater defense for your harvesting operation.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: The despised Ordos are well established in this region, and are harvesting spice that should rightfully belong to House Harkonnen. Destroy the Ordos installations in this area and assert control in the name of House Harkonnen.
TEXTH.ENG.text: The despised Ordos are well established in this region, and are harvesting spice that should rightfully belong to House Harkonnen. Destroy the Ordos installations in this area and assert control in the name of House Harkonnen.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: Congratulations. You are making progress. Several of my associates have expressed pessimistic thoughts concerning your abilities, and I am glad that you have proved them wrong. Let us see now if my confidence in you is misplaced.
TEXTH.ENG.text: Congratulations. You are making progress. Several of my associates have expressed pessimistic thoughts concerning your abilities, and I am glad that you have proved them wrong. Let us see now if my confidence in you is misplaced.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: I knew it!  Several of my associates had expressed confidence in your abilities, but I knew that you were too weak to be a Harkonnen commander! Guards! Remove this stench before it fouls the entire planet!
TEXTH.ENG.text: I knew it!  Several of my associates had expressed confidence in your abilities, but I knew that you were too weak to be a Harkonnen commander! Guards! Remove this stench before it fouls the entire planet!

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: You need to build a Light Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.
TEXTH.ENG.text: You need to build a Light Factory to produce the weapons necessary to complete your mission.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: One small victory does not win the war. Another region has the misfortune to be infested with vermin from House Ordos, and you must now repeat your success. I have many delicate political negotiations on my mind, and I don't need to be worrying about loose ends.
TEXTH.ENG.text: One small victory does not win the war. Another region has the misfortune to be infested with vermin from House Ordos, and you must now repeat your success. I have many delicate political negotiations on my mind, and I don't need to be worrying about loose ends.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: Well done. The Ordos dogs make amusing noises when they die, do they not? Indeed, what good is our life if we cannot enjoy the simple pleasures?
TEXTH.ENG.text: Well done. The Ordos dogs make amusing noises when they die, do they not? Indeed, what good is our life if we cannot enjoy the simple pleasures?

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: Is this the way you repay my faith in you?  Such a serious loss could only have been deliberate!  You are unfit to clean our latrines, much less command our glorious Troopers!
TEXTH.ENG.text: Is this the way you repay my faith in you?  Such a serious loss could only have been deliberate!  You are unfit to clean our latrines, much less command our glorious Troopers!

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: The addition of tanks in your forces is essential to your victory in this region.
TEXTH.ENG.text: The addition of tanks in your forces is essential to your victory in this region.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: So, the Emperor was helping the Ordos in your last mission. Never the less, House Atreides has grown stronger due to our negligence, and must now be taught a lesson. You will remove all the Atreides from this region.
TEXTH.ENG.text: So, the Emperor was helping the Ordos in your last mission. Never the less, House Atreides has grown stronger due to our negligence, and must now be taught a lesson. You will remove all the Atreides from this region.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: In appreciation for your recent performance, I will now allow you to resume the struggle with the Ordos. At least they will put up a fight worthy of our Troopers.
TEXTH.ENG.text: In appreciation for your recent performance, I will now allow you to resume the struggle with the Ordos. At least they will put up a fight worthy of our Troopers.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: Perhaps you miss your mother?  I am worried about you and cannot let you progress further until you have proved yourself against the Atreides.
TEXTH.ENG.text: Perhaps you miss your mother?  I am worried about you and cannot let you progress further until you have proved yourself against the Atreides.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: The production of Carryalls will greatly speed up your harvesting operations.

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: You are to proceed into yet another luckless region dominated by those pesky Ordos, and I expect you to overcome this particularly troublesome Ordos group. We have established a good reputation on this planet. Do not embarrass me now!
TEXTH.ENG.text: You are to proceed into yet another luckless region dominated by those pesky Ordos, and I expect you to overcome this particularly troublesome Ordos group. We have established a good reputation on this planet. Do not embarrass me now!

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: The victor's laurels fit you well my son!  I may even refer other aspirants to study your tactics. I would personally apologize for having underestimated the Ordos strength in your last campaign, but that is no longer a relevant concern of ours, is it?

TEXTH.ENG.digram_expanded: Surely this is a tasteless joke?  How could you manage such a defeat? I may have to slit your throat myself just to calm down!  Did you plan to fail in revenge for some imagined wrong?

TEXTO.ENG.digram_expanded: Your clumsy management has cost us dearly! This is not a game. We cannot just start over every time you fail to concentrate on the task before you. I suggest you rid yourself of all outside interests and devote yourself completely to your next assignment!

TEXTO.ENG.digram_expanded: A masterful victory, but be cautious! Your reputation will now precede you in future engagements, and you may find your foes better prepared for your tactics.

TEXTO.ENG.text: The addition of tanks in your forces is essential to your victory in this region.

TEXTO.ENG.digram_expanded: Congratulations would be in order, but we expect these results when you are in charge. Your continued success brings honor to your family, and all of us in House Ordos.
